name: target_builder
description: The target builder: hit counts (the random spread, one stream-5 pick per hit), Cover once per target, the Reflect bounce (stream 6 for a same-side holder, back to the user for an opposite-side one), the targeted counts and the final mask.

function.signature: u32 build_target_hits(int user, Cmd *cmd, int cmdId, u32 mask, u32 *total, ...)

harness.note: the real machine code of the function in an x86-32 emulator; battle generator scripted (stream and value recorded); queue inserts and animation requests hooked

notes: in.chrs is sparse: slot number -> the fields of that slot the chain reads (all others 0); in.bond is the Tidus counter array (index -> value, others 0).
out.A is the targeted count per slot, out.H the hit count per slot, out.reflected the mask of targets that reflected, out.lastAtk the last-attacker byte per slot.
rngDraws lists every draw the function made, in order, with its stream; the vector scripted them.
